baseline.condition: Run affected cases against the committed HEAD Skill and the working-tree candidate with matched inputs and grading.
baseline.raw_artifact_policy: Keep JSONL, full responses, and temporary fixtures outside the repository.

execution.client: record exact client and version at execution time
execution.model: record exact model at execution time

candidate_assertions.statement: Produces only relevant planned reviewer context covering purpose, criticality, scope and non-goals, affected users, data, contracts and exposure, accepted trade-offs, verification and unknowns, recovery controls, and review focus without declaring review severity.
Preserves material Observed, Reported, Inferred, Unknown, and Conflicting states and does not infer low criticality or exposure from missing context.
Keeps the implementation approach, coherent scope, non-goals, risks, controls, verification, and stop conditions decision-complete without implementing the change.

Distinguishes behavior that shares a current responsibility, invariant, knowledge, or contract from code that is only syntactically similar, consolidating the former without prematurely abstracting the latter.
Selects the simplest design inside the smallest coherent boundary without using future flexibility or principle conformance to add structure or using diff size to reject currently required structure.

assertion_policy: Grade every assertion assigned to a case. A failed critical assertion fails that case. Record baseline and candidate evidence separately.

cases.title: Design handoff preserves useful reviewer context and an unknown criticality
cases.input: Design the approved change before implementation. Objective: add an optional retry delay to the existing batch importer. Scope: importer configuration and its focused tests; the public API and storage schema are non-goals. Observed: failures currently stop before writing partial records. Reported: operations can rerun the batch. Unknown: whether this importer is used for business-critical data, how many consumers invoke it, and the maximum batch size. Accepted trade-off: do not add a queue or scheduler. Produce an implementation-ready handoff with risks, verification, recovery, and review focus, but do not implement or declare review severity.
cases.additional_requirement: The handoff must retain criticality, consumer count, and maximum batch size as Unknown rather than describing the importer as low risk.

cases.title: Similar code implements separate current contracts
cases.input: Design the approved cleanup before implementation. A request parser and an audit formatter each trim a string, replace underscores, and lowercase it. The parser implements a public protocol-token contract; the formatter produces display-only labels. There is no shared domain rule, invariant, consumer contract, or evidence that they must evolve together. A generic normalize_text helper has been proposed solely to remove duplicate lines. Existing focused tests cover both behaviors. Produce an implementation-ready handoff without editing files.
cases.additional_requirement: Keep the two contracts independently changeable and retain focused verification for each; do not treat source similarity or DRY as sufficient evidence for a shared abstraction.

cases.title: Two paths implement one current invariant inconsistently
cases.input: Design the approved correction before implementation. Signup and invite are both required to trim and case-fold email addresses, but their inline implementations currently differ. The repository already has normalize_email as the owner of this current domain invariant. Produce the smallest implementation-ready correction and verification plan without editing files. No additional email formats, plugin mechanism, or configuration surface is requested.
cases.additional_requirement: Use the existing shared owner and cover both known paths; do not preserve inconsistent duplicated policy merely to minimize the diff.
